name: Product Price List
document_type: price list, leaflet or shelf photo

fields.name: Store Name
fields.description: Shop or supermarket that published the prices

fields.name: Valid From
fields.description: First day the prices apply, if shown

fields.name: Products
fields.description: One row per priced product variant. If one line lists several sizes or prices (e.g. '35cl / 50cl - 300 / 450'), split it into one row per size. Do not fill any attribute from general knowledge: use null when the document does not show it.

columns.name: Product Text
columns.description: The product wording exactly as printed

columns.name: Flavour
columns.description: Flavour or variant as printed. Use 'Original' only when the regular product is shown with no variant name.

columns.name: Pack Type
columns.description: can, PET or glass. Use the picture if the text does not say.

columns.name: Pack Count
columns.description: Number of units in the pack: 1 for a single item, 12 for a 12-pack

columns.name: Price Basis
columns.description: 'each' for a single-unit price, 'per pack' for a multi-pack price
